notes.title: Major update, changing game direction
notes.content:
Svarog's Dream has undergone a major transformation and is now a Tower Defense game.
Based on player feedback, the game has been updated to include more monsters and mobs, particularly in the early stages.
Players will now defend villages from hordes of monsters in waves by constructing futuristic weapons.
Coins will be rewarded for each defeated wave, which can be used to upgrade defenses.
The game now features 6 new rocket turrets and 2 laser turrets to enhance gameplay.


We have added more zombies in the game, they are everywhere! 
Players can no longer leave villages as they will be attacked by hordes of zombies.

Enjoy the game and have a happy start to April.

notes.title: Runes patch
notes.content:
After a player unlocks all spells, they can now spend points on passive talents. 
There are 28 new passive talents for players to choose from, and they are the same for every class. 
These talents are not as strong as core abilities, but they should gradually increase the player's strength. 
Each talent can be upgraded 5 times.

As a bonus update, some skills that do not require weapons can now be cast without a weapon equipped, 
such as placing a trap on the ground.
Second bonus update is that dexterity now grows with any piercing damage.
